chunks: And from him, from Fadala, from Husayn ibn 'Uthman, from Ibn Muskan, from Yazid mawla al-Hakam, from whoever narrated to him, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
I heard him (peace be upon him) say: 'To establish the call to prayer (iqamah) in pairs is more beloved to me than to call the adhan and establish the iqamah individually (one by one).'

key_terms.إِقَامَة: Iqamah (the call to prayer immediately preceding the congregational prayer)

ai.seo_question: What is the preferred method for performing the iqamah according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) expresses a preference for performing the iqamah 'two by two' (muthanna muthanna) rather than singly, reflecting the scholarly debate on whether the iqamah should be recited in pairs of phrases like the adhan. This preference underscores the ritual elegance and completeness associated with the congregational call, distinguishing the iqamah's structure from the adhan while emphasizing the importance of orderly preparation for prayer.
